# weather_client: instructions for coding agents

<!-- Generated by crucible. Change the model or the SDK configuration and regenerate. -->

This is the generated C client for the Weather API (`example.weather#Weather`, API version `2026-10-01`, sent as `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request). The names below are exact: do not guess other package, import or method names.

- Install: `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release`, then `cmake --build build --config Release`, then `cmake --install build --config Release --prefix "$HOME/.local"`, then in the manifest, `find_package(weather_client 0.0.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)` and `target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE weather_client::weather_client)`. Needs yyjson 0.13, libcurl 7.68 or newer and OpenSSL 1.1.1 or newer. The package is `weather_client` at version `0.0.0`.
- Import: `#include "weather_client/client.h"`.
- Client: `weather_client`. Construct it as below. `config.token` is the bearer token callback: the client calls it on every attempt (with `config.token_user`), so a refreshed token is used, and sends no token when it sets `*present` to false. The client copies `config`'s strings; free it with `weather_client_free` after its calls and iterators finish. `config.endpoint` is the service's base URL.

```c
#include "weather_client/client.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

/* The client asks for the token on every attempt, so a refreshed one is used. */
static weather_status read_token(void *user, const weather_scope *scope, weather_arena *arena,
    bool *present, weather_string *token, weather_error *error) {
    const char *value = getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN");
    (void)user;
    (void)scope;
    (void)arena;
    (void)error;
    *present = value != NULL;
    *token = weather_string_view(value);
    return weather_ok;
}

int main(void) {
    weather_error error = {0};
    weather_client_config config = weather_client_defaults();
    config.endpoint = weather_string_view(getenv("WEATHER_ENDPOINT"));
    config.token = read_token;
    weather_client *client = NULL;
    if (weather_client_new(&config, &client, &error) != weather_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "weather_client_new: %s\n", error.message);
        return 1;
    }
    /* Call operations with the client, then free it. */
    weather_client_free(client);
    return 0;
}
```

- Headers: The client sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request. Do not set them yourself.
- Operations: one method per operation, such as `weather_operations_create_city`, `weather_operations_get_city`, `weather_operations_get_city_photo`. Each takes its input type and returns its output type.
- Pagination: A paginated operation also has `<operation>_pages_new` (`weather_operations_list_cities_pages_new`), which takes the input and returns a `weather_pages` iterator, and `<operation>_pages_next`, which fills one page's result and sets `has_page` to false after the last one. Free each page's result with `<operation>_result_free` and the iterator with `weather_pages_free`.
- Errors: Every call returns a `weather_status`: `weather_service_error` for an HTTP error response, whose modelled error `weather_error_as_<error>(&result.base)` returns (`NULL` for another error) and whose status is `result.base.response.status`; `weather_network`, `weather_deadline`, `weather_cancelled` or `weather_invalid` otherwise, with `error.message`. Free the result after a failure too: it owns the error's data.
- Retries: automatic for safe calls; do not wrap calls in your own retry loop. Set `config.max_attempts` (3, the first included; 1 turns retries off), `config.timeout` (the whole call's budget in seconds) and `config.base_delay` and `config.max_delay` before constructing the client.
- Idempotency: these calls fill an idempotency token when it is unset: `weather_operations_create_city` (`weather_models_create_city_input_set_client_token`). Set it yourself to replay one logical request.
- Generated code: do not edit files in this package; they are replaced when it is regenerated.

## A complete call: `GetCity`

```c
#include "weather_client/client.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

/* The client asks for the token on every attempt, so a refreshed one is used. */
static weather_status read_token(void *user, const weather_scope *scope, weather_arena *arena,
    bool *present, weather_string *token, weather_error *error) {
    const char *value = getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN");
    (void)user;
    (void)scope;
    (void)arena;
    (void)error;
    *present = value != NULL;
    *token = weather_string_view(value);
    return weather_ok;
}

int main(void) {
    weather_error error = {0};
    /* The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request. */
    weather_client_config config = weather_client_defaults();
    config.endpoint = weather_string_view(getenv("WEATHER_ENDPOINT"));
    config.token = read_token;
    weather_client *client = NULL;
    if (weather_client_new(&config, &client, &error) != weather_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "weather_client_new: %s\n", error.message);
        return 1;
    }

    /* Values from the model's example "Read a city". */
    weather_models_get_city_input input = {0};
    weather_models_get_city_input_set_city_id(&input, weather_string_view("c-0a1b2c3d"));
    weather_models_get_city_input_set_at(&input, (weather_timestamp){1767323045, 0} /* 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z */);

    weather_operations_get_city_result result = {0};
    weather_status status = weather_operations_get_city(client, &input, NULL, NULL, &result, &error);
    if (status == weather_ok) {
        weather_string text = {0};
        if (weather_models_city_summary_debug(result.base.arena, weather_models_get_city_output_get_city(result.value), &text, &error) == weather_ok) printf("city: %.*s\n", (int)text.length, text.data);
        if (weather_models_get_city_output_has_forecast(result.value) && weather_models_forecast_debug(result.base.arena, weather_models_get_city_output_get_forecast(result.value), &text, &error) == weather_ok) printf("forecast: %.*s\n", (int)text.length, text.data);
        if (weather_models_get_city_output_has_request_id(result.value)) {
            text = weather_models_get_city_output_get_request_id(result.value);
            printf("requestId: %.*s\n", (int)text.length, text.data);
        }
    } else if (weather_error_as_not_found_error(&result.base) != NULL) {
        weather_string text = {0};
        const weather_models_not_found_error *failure = weather_error_as_not_found_error(&result.base);
        fprintf(stderr, "NotFoundError (HTTP %d)\n", result.base.response.status);
        text = weather_models_not_found_error_get_message(failure);
        fprintf(stderr, "message: %.*s\n", (int)text.length, text.data);
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "GetCity failed: %s\n", error.message);
    }
    weather_operations_get_city_result_free(&result);
    weather_client_free(client);
    return status == weather_ok ? 0 : 1;
}
```

## Pagination

A paginated operation also has `<operation>_pages_new` (`weather_operations_list_cities_pages_new`), which takes the input and returns a `weather_pages` iterator, and `<operation>_pages_next`, which fills one page's result and sets `has_page` to false after the last one. Free each page's result with `<operation>_result_free` and the iterator with `weather_pages_free`.

```c
#include "weather_client/client.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

/* The client asks for the token on every attempt, so a refreshed one is used. */
static weather_status read_token(void *user, const weather_scope *scope, weather_arena *arena,
    bool *present, weather_string *token, weather_error *error) {
    const char *value = getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN");
    (void)user;
    (void)scope;
    (void)arena;
    (void)error;
    *present = value != NULL;
    *token = weather_string_view(value);
    return weather_ok;
}

int main(void) {
    weather_error error = {0};
    /* The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request. */
    weather_client_config config = weather_client_defaults();
    config.endpoint = weather_string_view(getenv("WEATHER_ENDPOINT"));
    config.token = read_token;
    weather_client *client = NULL;
    if (weather_client_new(&config, &client, &error) != weather_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "weather_client_new: %s\n", error.message);
        return 1;
    }

    /* Values from the model's example "List the first page". */
    weather_string const input_tags_items[] = {
        weather_string_view("coastal"),
        weather_string_view("capital"),
    };
    weather_models_tags input_tags = {2, input_tags_items};
    weather_models_list_cities_input input = {0};
    weather_models_list_cities_input_set_max_results(&input, 2);
    weather_models_list_cities_input_set_tags(&input, &input_tags);

    /* Each page is one response; the iterator sends `nextToken` for the next. */
    weather_pages *pages = NULL;
    weather_status status = weather_operations_list_cities_pages_new(client, &input, NULL, NULL, &pages, &error);
    bool has_page = status == weather_ok;
    while (has_page) {
        weather_operations_list_cities_result page = {0};
        status = weather_operations_list_cities_pages_next(pages, &has_page, &page, &error);
        if (status == weather_ok && has_page) {
            weather_string text = {0};
            if (weather_models_city_summaries_debug(page.base.arena, weather_models_list_cities_output_get_cities(page.value), &text, &error) == weather_ok) printf("cities: %.*s\n", (int)text.length, text.data);
        }
        weather_operations_list_cities_result_free(&page);
        if (status != weather_ok) break;
    }
    if (status != weather_ok) fprintf(stderr, "ListCities failed: %s\n", error.message);
    weather_pages_free(pages);
    weather_client_free(client);
    return status == weather_ok ? 0 : 1;
}
```

## Errors

Every call returns a `weather_status`: `weather_service_error` for an HTTP error response, whose modelled error `weather_error_as_<error>(&result.base)` returns (`NULL` for another error) and whose status is `result.base.response.status`; `weather_network`, `weather_deadline`, `weather_cancelled` or `weather_invalid` otherwise, with `error.message`. Free the result after a failure too: it owns the error's data.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. These operations fill a token: `weather_operations_create_city` (`weather_models_create_city_input_set_client_token`). Set `config.max_attempts` (3, the first included; 1 turns retries off), `config.timeout` (the whole call's budget in seconds) and `config.base_delay` and `config.max_delay` before constructing the client.

 */
weather_status weather_operations_ping(weather_client *client, weather_cancelled_fn cancelled, void *cancel_user, weather_operations_ping_result *result, weather_error *error);
void weather_operations_ping_result_free(weather_operations_ping_result *result);

/** Zero-initialize results. Free before reuse; value borrows base.arena. */
typedef struct { weather_result base; const weather_models_put_city_photo_output *value; } weather_operations_put_city_photo_result;
/**
 * Stores a city's photo exactly as sent.
 *
 * Input: PutCityPhotoInput.
 *
 * Returns: PutCityPhotoOutput.
 *
 * Modeled errors: NotFoundError, ThrottlingError, ValidationError. Transport, timeout and decoding failures can also occur.
 *
 * This operation is safe to retry under the configured retry policy.
 */
weather_status weather_operations_put_city_photo(weather_client *client, const weather_models_put_city_photo_input *input, weather_cancelled_fn cancelled, void *cancel_user, weather_operations_put_city_photo_result *result, weather_error *error);
void weather_operations_put_city_photo_result_free(weather_operations_put_city_photo_result *result);

/** Zero-initialize results. Free before reuse; value borrows base.arena. */
typedef struct { weather_result base; const weather_models_status_output *value; } weather_operations_status_result;
/**
 * Call Status.
 *
 * Input: StatusInput.
 *
 * Returns: StatusOutput.
 *
 * Modeled errors: ThrottlingError, ValidationError. Transport, timeout and decoding failures can also occur.
 *
 * This operation is safe to retry under the configured retry policy.
 */
weather_status weather_operations_status(weather_client *client, const weather_models_status_input *input, weather_cancelled_fn cancelled, void *cancel_user, weather_operations_status_result *result, weather_error *error);
void weather_operations_status_result_free(weather_operations_status_result *result);
const weather_models_conflict_error *weather_error_as_conflict_error(const weather_result *result);
const weather_models_not_found_error *weather_error_as_not_found_error(const weather_result *result);
const weather_models_throttling_error *weather_error_as_throttling_error(const weather_result *result);
const weather_models_validation_error *weather_error_as_validation_error(const weather_result *result);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#endif

struct weather_models_city_summary {
    struct { weather_presence state; weather_string value; } id;
    struct { weather_presence state; weather_string value; } name;
    struct { weather_presence state; int64_t value; } population;
    struct { weather_presence state; weather_timestamp value; } updated_at;
    /**
     * @deprecated Use updatedAt. (since 2026-08)
     */
    struct { weather_presence state; weather_timestamp value; } created_at;
};

weather_status weather_client_new(const weather_client_config *config, weather_client **output, weather_error *error) {
    const weather_string endpoint = {"", 0};
    return weather_runtime_new(config, schema_chunks, sizeof(schema_chunks) / sizeof(schema_chunks[0]), endpoint, output, error);
}
weather_status weather_operations_create_city(weather_client *client, const weather_models_create_city_input *input, weather_cancelled_fn cancelled, void *cancel_user, weather_operations_create_city_result *result, weather_error *error) {
    const weather_string operation = {"CreateCity", 10};
    weather_status status;
    if (!result) return weather_client_call(client, operation, input, cancelled, cancel_user, NULL, error);
    result->value = NULL;
    status = weather_client_call(client, operation, input, cancelled, cancel_user, &result->base, error);
    if (status == weather_ok) result->value = (const weather_models_create_city_output *)result->base.output;
    return status;
}
void weather_operations_create_city_result_free(weather_operations_create_city_result *result) {
    if (result) { weather_result_free(&result->base); result->value = NULL; }
}

const weather_models_conflict_error *weather_error_as_conflict_error(const weather_result *result) {
    return result && result->error_shape == &weather_shape_11 ? (const weather_models_conflict_error *)result->modeled_error : NULL;
}
const weather_models_not_found_error *weather_error_as_not_found_error(const weather_result *result) {
    return result && result->error_shape == &weather_shape_24 ? (const weather_models_not_found_error *)result->modeled_error : NULL;
}
const weather_models_throttling_error *weather_error_as_throttling_error(const weather_result *result) {
    return result && result->error_shape == &weather_shape_33 ? (const weather_models_throttling_error *)result->modeled_error : NULL;
}
const weather_models_validation_error *weather_error_as_validation_error(const weather_result *result) {
    return result && result->error_shape == &weather_shape_35 ? (const weather_models_validation_error *)result->modeled_error : NULL;
}

}
